controlled_input_boundary: Structured claims and prior broad-retrieval no-rule-match states are frozen evaluation fixtures, not generated by the production upstream workflow.

qualification_rule: Controlled fixtures must be independently classified by production policy and yield both action types before any Provider request. Natural cases qualify only if real upstream extraction yields an independent mixed Claim with both safe action types.
success_rule: Real proposal chooses one of two safe types; Validator allows; execution yields an Observation changing the corresponding gap; recomputation removes that type and leaves another safe action type. No-hit or unchanged gap is not counted.
